from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class PerShareRecord(BaseModel):
    """A per-share financial metric extracted from a financial statement."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The registrant company name found in the document")
    label: str | None = Field(description="The exact line-item label as written (e.g., 'Basic Net Loss per Common Share')")
    value: float | None = Field(description="The per-share amount as a number; losses must be negative")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period for this data")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt containing the value and label")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    per_share_records: list[PerShareRecord]
